name: Eye of the Storm
source: A group of college girls who flee to a mountain resort to avoid a terrible storm. The caretaker (you) must do everything he can to keep them safe from the storm, each other, and someone that may or may not be lurking outside in the woods
translation: 一群女大学生逃到山区度假胜地以避免可怕的风暴。看门人（你）必须尽一切努力保护它们免受暴风雨、彼此以及可能潜伏在外面树林里的人的伤害
